title: A decent utilitarian paper towel and silverware holder
text:
A decent utilitarian paper towel and silverware holder. I was looking for a nice cabin centerpiece and this fills the need in utility anyway. In person it was not quite as rich looking as I was hoping, but it is ok.

The metal is ok as is the manufacturing. I can't say much against it, but I'm having troubles raving about it for anything. We were looking for a holder for towels, silverware, and plastic plates and it does that well enough
